labeller_note: I read batch-h5.json, vocabulary.md, the 13 workflow YAMLs and the top of workflow_registry.py, nothing else. A result is labelled only when words name it. Several results have no method named in their words: these list every PRODUCES id that gives the result, respecting per-sample vs whole-cohort, regulator kinds (TF-only asks exclude the PUMA family; asks that leave the regulator kind open include it) and sign. The words 'the network' after 'Run PANDA', 'BONOBO networks' and 'LIONESS-COEXPRESSION networks' point back to the named method, so they get only that method's id. A run of one named method with no result words ('Run PUMA', 'Launch OTTER', 'Run COBRA') is labelled with that method's main result and a why saying it is implied. A request with no named or implied result has empty results and a note (open questions, 'run something', 'some insight'). Settings use the vocabulary's WORKFLOW.setting. log2-transformed and mean-centered statements count as BONOBO's declaration settings. 'MSigDB pathway GMT' counts as SAMBAR.gmt_msigdb. 'keep the full matrices and save a p-value matrix' is labelled as sparsify plus save_pvals, from BONOBO's conditional_outputs. Output paths and folders are destinations, not method settings, so they are not labelled. Header and orientation descriptions are labelled only where a setting exists (PANDA.with_header). Has slots follow the role the data would fill. Two matched omics tables named for a two-layer request, or given without any result, go to omics_layer_1/omics_layer_2 in order of mention. Samples named as the thing to analyse ('our 18 placenta samples') are recorded as implied expression_file with a why. Source links are recorded when words tie a result to particular data: 'from/out of/built on/based on/linking/combining X', or the primary data file of 'Run W on F'. Prior files after 'with' are not source links.
